text:
Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town. Weekdays: out 08:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Felix (knitting, movies, family calls); Aisha (running, houseplants, movies, family calls).

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their Tuesday 18:00 walkthrough locations. Key changes observed on Monday:

Entry:
- Aisha’s items (backpack, headphones, jacket, keys, lunchbox, notebook, pen, scarf, shoes, wallet, water bottle) are out during the day and returned to entry by 20:00.
- Felix’s items (backpack, charger, headphones, jacket, laptop, scarf, keys, wallet, shoes, water bottle, umbrella) are out during the day and returned to entry by 20:00.
- Shared: toolbox, vacuum cleaner on floor.
- Aisha’s running shoes move from shoe rack to entry floor in late afternoon before returning.

Kitchen:
- Counter: kettle, knife block, toaster, wall clock, vitamins (Felix).
- Cupboard: duster, glass (Aisha), bowl (Aisha), bowl (Felix), mug (Aisha), plate (Felix), serving dish, snack bowl, lunchbox (Aisha).
- Table: fruit bowl, glass (Felix), plate (Felix), water bottle (Felix).
- Sink: soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, mug (Aisha), bowl (Aisha).
- Dish rack: glass (Aisha), water bottle (Aisha), water bottle (Felix).
- Drawer: kitchen knife, spatula.
- Pantry: shopping bag.
- Note: Kitchen items (knives, pans, dishes) cycle between sink, counter, cupboard, and table during meal prep and cleanup, typically settling in cupboard/dish rack by 21:55.

Living:
- Couch: blanket, cushion 1, knitting bag (Felix).
- Coffee table: candle, coasters, tissue box.
- Bookshelf: board game, picture frame, speaker, vase.
- TV stand: remote.
- Side table: lamp.
- Armchair: cushion 2.

Bedroom 1:
- Nightstand: books (Aisha, Felix), glasses (Aisha), tablets (Aisha, Felix), phone (Aisha), headphones (Aisha).
- Desk: laptop (Aisha), charger (Felix), laptop (Felix), headphones (Felix), notebook (Aisha), pen (Aisha).
- Dresser: hair dryer (Felix).
- Floor: ironing board.
- Bed: empty.
- Wardrobe: empty.

Bathroom:
- Shelf: detergent, laundry basket, skincare (Aisha), skincare (Felix), towel (Felix).
- Medicine cabinet: medication (Aisha).
- Sink: soap dispenser, toothbrush holder, razor (Aisha), razor (Felix).
- Towel rack: towels (Aisha).

Balcony:
- Floor: watering can.
- Table: spray bottle, gardening gloves.

Office:
- All spots empty.

Notes:
- Aisha’s and Felix’s work/errand items (laptops, bags, keys, phones, etc.) are typically out during the day and returned to entry by evening.
- Phones are left in living/bedroom when home, taken out when leaving. Aisha’s phone was found on nightstand at 20:00; Felix’s was on nightstand at 00:00.
- Skincare items moved from medicine cabinet to bathroom shelf at 12:00.
- Friends visited Friday evening; no items removed from house.
